actual_mechanism_observations.observation: Secondary-use server branch writes CODEC-encoded BlockPos to target_ + current dimension ID on physical stack; writes one key and preserves unrelated root tags. Client branch emits particles only.
getBinding decodes only current dimension entry; absent/bad data yields null. Tooltip query does not delete bad location; it is presentation, not the live travel consumer.

Finished use directly rereads same stack key; absent returns stack, codec failure removes only that dimension key. Valid entry computes integer distance*10, checks exact payment for Player then teleports to centre+1.5Y. Valid destination remains reusable; insufficient payment keeps it. Non-player LivingEntity bypasses player mana check.

Reads inventory/offhand plus extensible list and accessories, skips identical requesting ItemStack object, accumulates provider plan. Only exact collected sum enters addMana(-planned) loop. This is not proof of valid untrusted providers, de-duplicated provider accounting or teleport transaction atomicity.

Server inventoryTick invokes relic.tickBinding. Malformed soulbindUUID parsing deletes key. If encountered within tickBinding, that same call can immediately bind to current player and fire advancement; it need not wait another tick. A tooltip-triggered invalid-UUID read may instead clear first and leave binding to later server inventoryTick. Generic relic binding is support only.

Forge capability map registers flugelEye coordinate and relic wrappers. Eye use/useOn/finish paths shown contain no explicit isRightPlayer guard; wrong-owner periodic damage is not a teleport permission gate.

instance comes from ServiceLoader; no provider gives default requestManaExact=false, multiple providers throw. Reviewed Java cache contains no META-INF/services registration file, so actual runtime selection of ManaItemHandlerImpl is not independently established. Concrete algorithm is source support, not proof it ran.

complete_limits: Static upstream reference only; no Dynasty code, no live action/restore test or native disk save/load proof. ItemStack serializer/codec internals and all event/accessory providers not inspected.

No target-level switch: current dimension chooses entry; do not claim cross-dimension travel or dimension rename/legacy remap support.
Malformed current entry selectively removed; no schema version upgrade, backup or recovery of that deleted location; other-dimension entries are not validated in this call.
No explicit loaded-chunk, collision/safe arrival or teleport-success/refund transaction in shown consumer; payment precedes teleport call.
Integer distance conversion has no explicit cost bounds here. No proof against negative API costs, malicious providers or duplicate ManaItem map overwrite.
No explicit wrong-player use guard; malformed soulbind can rebind current carrier, so ownership is not crafting history or original acquisition proof.
No proof of who crafted a four-NBT variant; tooltip, pickup, item possession, UUID rebind and successful travel are not recipe completion receipts.
Mana service registration/resources not present in inspected Java snapshot; no claim loaded implementation or runtime service invariant.
No new official provenance request, archive hash recheck, performance, multiplayer or survival acceptance.
